query: SELECT mc.characterName, mc.imageUrl, ms.name as setName FROM marvel_cards mc JOIN marvel_sets ms ON mc.setId = ms.id WHERE mc.characterName IN ('Deadpool', 'Magneto', 'Professor X', 'Scarlet Witch', 'Shang-Chi', 'Thing', 'Sentry') AND (ms.name LIKE '%Sapphire%' OR ms.name LIKE '%Chrome%' OR ms.name LIKE '%Comic Book Heroes%') LIMIT 15;
